review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -35,46 +35,25 @@ variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
   {X : Type*} [Module R A] [Coalgebra R A]
 
 variable (R A X) in
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X)]
review_comments.body: I think you need the `(relevant_arg := X)` on all of the declarations in this file

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -35,46 +35,25 @@ variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
   {X : Type*} [Module R A] [Coalgebra R A]
 
 variable (R A X) in
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X)]

@@ -35,46 +35,25 @@ variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
   {X : Type*} [Module R A] [Coalgebra R A]
 
 variable (R A X) in
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X)]
review_comments.body:
If there is a multiplicative type class argument on `X`, then it can infer the relevant_arg based on that. But in this file there is no such hint, so it can't figure this out.

Hopefully this won't be necessary anymore in the future, with a better algorithm/heuristic.

   {X : Type*} [Module R A] [Coalgebra R A]
 
 variable (R A X) in
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X)]
 instance instCoalgebra : Coalgebra R A[X] := Finsupp.instCoalgebra R X A
 
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X)]
 instance instIsCocomm [IsCocomm R A] : IsCocomm R A[X] := Finsupp.instIsCocomm R X A
 
-@[simp]
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X) (attr := simp)]
 lemma counit_single (x : X) (a : A) :
     Coalgebra.counit (single x a) = Coalgebra.counit (R := R) a :=
   Finsupp.counit_single _ _ _ _ _
 
-@[simp]
+@[to_additive (relevant_arg := X) (attr := simp)]
 lemma comul_single (x : X) (a : A) :
     Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (single x a) =
       TensorProduct.map (lsingle x) (lsingle x) (Coalgebra.comul a) :=
